name: Ob Nixilis, the Ascended
description: A demonic general freed from his contract by angels in Capenna who vowed to serve them.

timeline.summary: Angels burn the demonic contract out of Ob Nixilis and he vows to serve them.
timeline.quote: The angels there burned the contract out of him, and, in gratitude, Ob Nixilis vowed to serve them.
